column1: # uLTRA equivalence corpora.
# Rule 5 of this port: verify on 5+ real datasets, not the repo's smoke corpus.
# test/reads.fa is FOUR reads and is blind to essentially every parameter, so it
# is a smoke case only and is never on its own a green result.
# READS ARE NOT COMMITTED. This repository's other goal is to shrink from 2.1 GB,
# so committing gigabytes of fastq would be self-defeating. Every row pins a
# sha256 for the reference, the annotation AND the reads;
# bench/corpora_resolve.sh resolves a row to local paths and verifies all three
# before any run. A silently-substituted corpus is exactly the kind of thing that
# makes a suite green for the wrong reason.
# Kristoffer confirmed (2026-09-19) that everything under /Users/krsa3529/data in
# annotations/, lrRNA-seq/ and genomes/ is public. $ULTRA_DATA points there
# (default $HOME/data). Sources written as http(s) URLs are fetched and cached
# under $ULTRA_BENCH_CACHE (default $HOME/.cache/ultra-bench).
# COVERAGE NOTE. sirv-* all share ONE reference: 7 sequences, a 339-line GTF.
# That is fine for the align stage and useless for the index stage, which is the
# largest rewrite in the port. droso-20k exists to close that gap: a real genome
# (143 MB, 55 contigs) and a real annotation (167 MB, 24 278 genes, 41 610
# transcripts, 196 625 exons). Do not drop it to save time.
# columns:
#   name  tier  ref  ref_sha256  gtf  gtf_sha256  reads  reads_sha256  notes
#   tier: smoke | core | heavy      (heavy is opt-in via CORPORA=heavy)
#   gtf "-" means the corpus is align-only and reuses another corpus's index.
